transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?
Lately I can’t think clearly or concentrate the way I used to at work, and it feels like my mind just won’t stay organized. It's making it really hard to keep up with everything at the salon.
Have you noticed any confusion, memory problems, or feeling mentally foggy, or is it mainly trouble focusing and staying organized?

It’s definitely both. My brain fogs over so badly that I'll reread the same line five times and completely forget what a client just told me about their hair history. I even get frozen trying to make simple decisions, like which developer to grab, even though I've done it a thousand times before.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or lost interest in things you used to enjoy, even outside of work?

Yes, I feel deeply down and empty, like there's this heavy gray cloud sitting on my chest all the time. I've completely lost interest in things I used to love, like my hiking club and volunteering, and when friends invite me out or my mom calls, I just feel too blank to care.
How long has this low mood and lack of interest been going on, and have you had similar episodes in the past?

I've felt this heavy and empty pretty much every day for a little over a year now, ever since the pressure at the salon got to be too much. I've never had episodes like this in the past before all of this started about two years ago.
Have you had any periods lasting several weeks or more in the past where your mood improved and you felt back to normal before this current episode started?

No, I haven't really had any long stretches of feeling normal at all. Looking back over the whole time since things started going downhill at the salon, I can't recall more than a few brief weeks at a time where I didn't feel deeply down, empty, and guilty almost every single day.
